data.found_evidence: In lane-pin-refresh's event log: ask.requested Q4fb19316c9 11:27:21Z, ask.answered Q4fb19316c9 11:27:22Z by policy:pins_regenerate (outcome approved), ask.consumed Q4fb19316c9 11:27:22Z. `pins regenerate --only result-schemas` then ran its pre-check test (tests/test_compat_json.py::test_every_cli_command_is_named_by_the_tool_that_serves_it failed because of main-red B5577fd488d), printed "Its files were put back as they were" and recorded nothing. The retry at 11:28:35Z was refused (single use per recipe and item already spent) and filed Q5cf5e59913, which stayed pending until a person approved it at 11:29:51Z. Expected: the use is spent only once the recipe has actually re-recorded; a refused or failed recipe should leave the use available (or the refusal should say the use was spent by an earlier failed run).
data.summary: standing rule pins_regenerate spends its single use on a recipe that then refuses to record, and the retry files a new request
data.title: pins_regenerate policy use consumed by a refused recipe

data.body:
Fixes bug Bebbcb8261c: standing rule pins_regenerate spends its single use on a recipe that then refuses to record, and the retry files a new request Found on PIN-refresh-main.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bebbcb8261c --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bebbcb8261c --regression-test <test>` first).

Not attached, they match nothing in the tree: ddflow/services/pins/refresh_main.py, tests/test_pins_refresh_main.py.
